composition_subtypes.role: Binary search on minimal time t
Min-heap to manage active intervals during sweep
Counter as difference array for interval coverage accumulation

payload.core_composition_summary: binary search over time; interior sweep-line uses priority queue and difference array (Counter) to verify coverage
payload.rationale: Outer binary search locates minimal time. In check, sorted points are swept with a heap tracking active intervals and a Counter implementing imos to compute coverage overlap along orthogonal axis.
